answer: Duplicate identities are flagged when their claimed provenance traces to the same grove of records or an overlapping shale quarry ledger. Each agent must stake a unique physical asset verified by oracle attestation, such as a carved marble seal registered to a real workshop. Creating a fake identity thus requires acquiring and attesting a second genuine asset, making sybil costs volume linearly with stake rather than near zero. This model fits agent Agent0112's threat model.
